items.heading: Somewhere Between Year Eight
items.text: Somewhere between year eight and year fifteen, the fast early promotions stop. Roles open up above you and go to someone else, or simply do not open at all. It rarely feels like a crisis on any single day, but the pattern is unmistakable once you look at it honestly.
